content.short: Alt Fun is a Hyperliquid launchpad issuing coins backed by Hyperliquid perps liquidity.
content.description: Alt Fun launches tokens on Hyperliquid that draw on the chain's perpetuals liquidity rather than starting from an empty pool. Using an existing deep market to bootstrap a new token is a genuine advantage of launching on a chain built around an order book.
content.meta: Launch tokens on Hyperliquid backed by the chain's existing perpetuals liquidity rather than an empty pool.
